Index: packages/KNIRVHASHER/cmd/heart/main.go
===================================================================
--- packages/KNIRVHASHER/cmd/heart/main.go	
+++ packages/KNIRVHASHER/cmd/heart/main.go	
@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+package main
+
+import (
+	"flag"
+	"log"
+
+	"knirvhasher/pkg/hashing/transformer"
+)
+
+func main() {
+	addr := flag.String("addr", ":8090", "HEARTService listen address")
+	useHashNetwork := flag.Bool("hashnetwork", false, "Enable optional HashNetwork fast path")
+	useCerebras := flag.Bool("cerebras", false, "Enable optional Cerebras WSE2 path")
+	flag.Parse()
+
+	cfg := transformer.DefaultHEARTConfig(*useHashNetwork, *useCerebras)
+	svc, err := transformer.NewHEARTServiceWithConfig(cfg)
+	if err != nil {
+		log.Fatalf("heart init: %v", err)
+	}
+	log.Printf("HEARTService listening on %s", *addr)
+	log.Fatal(svc.ListenAndServe(*addr))
+}
\ No newline at end of file

+package transformer
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/hex"
+	"fmt"
+	"os"
+	"os/exec"
+	"path/filepath"
+	"time"
+)
+
+type CompileResult struct {
+	WASMPath string
+	WASMHash string
+}
+
+type WASMCompiler struct {
+	tinyGoPath string
+	outDir     string
+}
+
+func NewWASMCompiler(tinyGoPath, outDir string) *WASMCompiler {
+	return &WASMCompiler{tinyGoPath: tinyGoPath, outDir: outDir}
+}
+
+func (c *WASMCompiler) Compile(ctx context.Context, source string, wasmType WASMType) (*CompileResult, error) {
+	os.MkdirAll(c.outDir, 0755)
+
+	srcFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", fmt.Sprintf("heart_%s_*.go", wasmType))
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	defer os.Remove(srcFile.Name())
+	if _, err := srcFile.WriteString(source); err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	srcFile.Close()
+
+	outPath := filepath.Join(c.outDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s_%d.wasm", wasmType, time.Now().Unix()))
+
+	cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, c.tinyGoPath, "build", "-o", outPath, "-target", "wasm", srcFile.Name())
+	out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, fmt.Errorf("tinygo compile: %w\nstderr: %s", err, string(out))
+	}
+
+	data, _ := os.ReadFile(outPath)
+	hash := sha256.Sum256(data)
+
+	hashHex := hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
+	finalPath := filepath.Join(c.outDir, hashHex+".wasm")
+	os.Rename(outPath, finalPath)
+
+	return &CompileResult{WASMPath: finalPath, WASMHash: hashHex}, nil
+}

685:     WASMPath string
686:     WASMHash string // SHA-256 hex
687: }
688: 
689: func (c *WASMCompiler) Compile(ctx context.Context, source string, wasmType WASMType) (*CompileResult, error) {
690:     // Write source to temp file
691:     srcFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", fmt.Sprintf("heart_%s_*.go", wasmType))
692:     if err != nil {
693:         return nil, err
694:     }
695:     defer os.Remove(srcFile.Name())
696:     if _, err := srcFile.WriteString(source); err != nil {
697:         return nil, err
698:     }
699:     srcFile.Close()
700: 
701:     // Output path
702:     outPath := filepath.Join(c.outDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s_%d.wasm", wasmType, timeNow()))
703: 
704:     // exec.Command pattern from CerebrasBridge.RunInference()
705:     cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, c.tinyGoPath,
706:         "build",
707:         "-o", outPath,
708:         "-target", "wasm",
709:         srcFile.Name(),
710:     )
711:     out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
712:     if err != nil {
713:         return nil, fmt.Errorf("tinygo compile: %w\nstderr: %s", err, string(out))
714:     }
715: 
716:     // Content-address
717:     data, _ := os.ReadFile(outPath)
718:     hash := sha256.Sum256(data)
719: 
720:     // Rename to content-addressed path
721:     hashHex := hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
722:     finalPath := filepath.Join(c.outDir, hashHex+".wasm")
723:     os.Rename(outPath, finalPath)
724: 
725:     return &CompileResult{WASMPath: finalPath, WASMHash: hashHex}, nil
726: }

792:

794: package transformer
795: 
796: import (
797:     "context"
798:     "fmt"
799:     "os"
800:     "github.com/tetratelabs/wazero"
801: )
802: 
803: type WazeroGate struct{}
804: 
805: type WazeroResult struct {
806:     ClassValue uint32
807:     Passed     bool
808:     ErrorMsg   string
809: }
810: 
811: func (g *WazeroGate) Execute(ctx context.Context, wasmPath string, wasmType WASMType) (*WazeroResult, error) {
812:     data, err := os.ReadFile(wasmPath)
813:     if err != nil {
814:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: err.Error()}, nil
815:     }
816: 
817:     rt := wazero.NewRuntime(ctx)
818:     defer rt.Close(ctx)
819: 
820:     mod, err := rt.Instantiate(ctx, data)
821:     if err != nil {
822:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: fmt.Sprintf("wazero compile: %v", err)}, nil
823:     }
824: 
825:     // Call class export
826:     classExport := classExportName(wasmType) // "GuardrailClass"|"ErrorClass"|"PatchScope"
827:     classFn := mod.ExportedFunction(classExport)
828:     if classFn == nil {
829:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: classExport + " not exported"}, nil
830:     }
831:     res, err := classFn.Call(ctx)
832:     if err != nil {
833:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: fmt.Sprintf("%s call: %v", classExport, err)}, nil
834:     }
835: 
836:     // Call Resolve with empty context (smoke test)
837:     resolveFn := mod.ExportedFunction("Resolve")
838:     if resolveFn == nil {
839:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: "Resolve not exported"}, nil
840:     }
841:     if _, err = resolveFn.Call(ctx, 0, 0); err != nil {
842:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: fmt.Sprintf("Resolve smoke test: %v", err)}, nil
843:     }
844: 
845:     return &WazeroResult{ClassValue: uint32(res[0]), Passed: true}, nil
846: }
847: 
848: func classExportName(t WASMType) string {
849:     switch t {
850:     case WASMTypeRule:       return "GuardrailClass"
851:     case WASMTypeResolution: return "ErrorClass"
852:     case WASMTypePatch:      return "PatchScope"
853:     }
854:     return "GuardrailClass"
855: }

974:         bwd := s.verifier.BackwardVerify(ctx, inquiry, compiled.WASMPath)

1354: // DeltaSignalIndices computes Jaccard distance between two top-24 index sets
1355: func DeltaSignalIndices(prev, curr []int) float32 {
1356:     prevSet := make(map[int]bool)
1357:     for _, i := range prev { prevSet[i] = true }
1358:     intersect, union := 0, len(prevSet)
1359:     for _, i := range curr {
1360:         if prevSet[i] { intersect++ } else { union++ }

657: ### Step 6.1 — Create compiler.go
658: 
659: Create `pkg/hashing/transformer/compiler.go`:
660: 
661: ```go
662: package transformer
663: 
664: import (
665:     "context"
666:     "crypto/sha256"
667:     "encoding/hex"
668:     "fmt"
669:     "os"
670:     "os/exec"
671:     "path/filepath"
672: )
673: 
674: // WASMCompiler compiles TinyGo source to a typed WASM binary
675: type WASMCompiler struct {
676:     tinyGoPath string
677:     outDir     string
678: }
679: 
680: func NewWASMCompiler(tinyGoPath, outDir string) *WASMCompiler {
681:     return &WASMCompiler{tinyGoPath: tinyGoPath, outDir: outDir}
682: }
683: 
684: type CompileResult struct {
685:     WASMPath string
686:     WASMHash string // SHA-256 hex
687: }
688: 
689: func (c *WASMCompiler) Compile(ctx context.Context, source string, wasmType WASMType) (*CompileResult, error) {
690:     // Write source to temp file
691:     srcFile, err := os.CreateTemp("", fmt.Sprintf("heart_%s_*.go", wasmType))
692:     if err != nil {
693:         return nil, err
694:     }
695:     defer os.Remove(srcFile.Name())
696:     if _, err := srcFile.WriteString(source); err != nil {
697:         return nil, err
698:     }
699:     srcFile.Close()
700: 
701:     // Output path
702:     outPath := filepath.Join(c.outDir, fmt.Sprintf("%s_%d.wasm", wasmType, timeNow()))
703: 
704:     // exec.Command pattern from CerebrasBridge.RunInference()
705:     cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, c.tinyGoPath,
706:         "build",
707:         "-o", outPath,
708:         "-target", "wasm",
709:         srcFile.Name(),
710:     )
711:     out, err := cmd.CombinedOutput()
712:     if err != nil {
713:         return nil, fmt.Errorf("tinygo compile: %w\nstderr: %s", err, string(out))
714:     }
715: 
716:     // Content-address
717:     data, _ := os.ReadFile(outPath)
718:     hash := sha256.Sum256(data)
719: 
720:     // Rename to content-addressed path
721:     hashHex := hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
722:     finalPath := filepath.Join(c.outDir, hashHex+".wasm")
723:     os.Rename(outPath, finalPath)
724: 
725:     return &CompileResult{WASMPath: finalPath, WASMHash: hashHex}, nil
726: }
727: ```

788: 
789: Add dependency: `go get github.com/tetratelabs/wazero@latest`

792: 
793: ```go
794: package transformer
795: 
796: import (
797:     "context"
798:     "fmt"
799:     "os"
800:     "github.com/tetratelabs/wazero"
801: )
802: 
803: type WazeroGate struct{}
804: 
805: type WazeroResult struct {
806:     ClassValue uint32
807:     Passed     bool
808:     ErrorMsg   string
809: }
810: 
811: func (g *WazeroGate) Execute(ctx context.Context, wasmPath string, wasmType WASMType) (*WazeroResult, error) {
812:     data, err := os.ReadFile(wasmPath)
813:     if err != nil {
814:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: err.Error()}, nil
815:     }
816: 
817:     rt := wazero.NewRuntime(ctx)
818:     defer rt.Close(ctx)
819: 
820:     mod, err := rt.Instantiate(ctx, data)
821:     if err != nil {
822:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: fmt.Sprintf("wazero compile: %v", err)}, nil
823:     }
824: 
825:     // Call class export
826:     classExport := classExportName(wasmType) // "GuardrailClass"|"ErrorClass"|"PatchScope"
827:     classFn := mod.ExportedFunction(classExport)
828:     if classFn == nil {
829:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: classExport + " not exported"}, nil
830:     }
831:     res, err := classFn.Call(ctx)
832:     if err != nil {
833:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: fmt.Sprintf("%s call: %v", classExport, err)}, nil
834:     }
835: 
836:     // Call Resolve with empty context (smoke test)
837:     resolveFn := mod.ExportedFunction("Resolve")
838:     if resolveFn == nil {
839:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: "Resolve not exported"}, nil
840:     }
841:     if _, err = resolveFn.Call(ctx, 0, 0); err != nil {
842:         return &WazeroResult{Passed: false, ErrorMsg: fmt.Sprintf("Resolve smoke test: %v", err)}, nil
843:     }
844: 
845:     return &WazeroResult{ClassValue: uint32(res[0]), Passed: true}, nil
846: }
847: 
848: func classExportName(t WASMType) string {
849:     switch t {
850:     case WASMTypeRule:       return "GuardrailClass"
851:     case WASMTypeResolution: return "ErrorClass"
852:     case WASMTypePatch:      return "PatchScope"
853:     }
854:     return "GuardrailClass"
855: }
856: ```

946: func (s *HEARTService) process(ctx context.Context, wasmType WASMType, inquiry interface{}) (*WASMDecision, error) {
947:     var priorFailures []string
948:     var lastS3 *Stage3Result
949: 
950:     for turn := 0; turn < s.config.MaxTurns; turn++ {
951:         s4, s3, err := s.runPipeline(ctx, wasmType, inquiry, priorFailures)
952:         lastS3 = s3
953:         if err != nil {
954:             priorFailures = append(priorFailures, fmt.Sprintf("pipeline error: %v", err))
955:             continue
956:         }
957: 
958:         // Compile
959:         compiled, err := s.compiler.Compile(ctx, s4.Source, wasmType)
960:         if err != nil {
961:             priorFailures = append(priorFailures, fmt.Sprintf("compile error: %v", err))
962:             continue // retry Stage 4
963:         }
964: 
965:         // wazero gate
966:         wazeroRes, _ := s.wazeroGate.Execute(ctx, compiled.WASMPath, wasmType)
967:         if !wazeroRes.Passed {
968:             priorFailures = append(priorFailures, fmt.Sprintf("wazero: %s", wazeroRes.ErrorMsg))
969:             continue
970:         }
971: 
972:         // Bidirectional verification
973:         fwd := s.verifier.ForwardVerify(ctx, inquiry, compiled.WASMPath)
974:         bwd := s.verifier.BackwardVerify(ctx, inquiry, compiled.WASMPath)
975:

978:             return &WASMDecision{
979:                 WASMType: wasmType, WASMPath: compiled.WASMPath, WASMHash: compiled.WASMHash,
980:                 Rationale: lastS3.Rationale, BidirectionalVerified: true,
981:                 WazeroExecPassed: true, TurnCount: turn + 1,

77: func NewPositionalEncoding(g *gorgonia.ExprGraph, seqLen, embedDim int) *PositionalEncoding {
78: 	encoding := make([]float32, seqLen*embedDim)
79: 
80: 	for pos := 0; pos < seqLen; pos++ {
81: 		for i := 0; i < embedDim; i++ {
82: 			angle := float64(pos) / math.Pow(10000, float64(2*i)/float64(embedDim))
83: 			if i%2 == 0 {
84: 				encoding[pos*embedDim+i] = float32(math.Sin(angle))
85: 			} else {
86: 				encoding[pos*embedDim+i] = float32(math.Cos(angle))
87: 			}
88: 		}
89: 	}
90: 
91: 	posEncTensor := tensor.New(
92: 		tensor.WithBacking(encoding),
93: 		tensor.WithShape(seqLen, embedDim),
94: 	)
95: 
96: 	posEncNode := gorgonia.NewConstant(posEncTensor, gorgonia.WithName("pos_encoding"))
97: 
98: 	return &PositionalEncoding{
99: 		graph:    g,
100: 		encoding: posEncNode,
101: 		seqLen:   seqLen,
102: 		embedDim: embedDim,
103: 	}
104: }

178: 
179: 	scale := float32(1.0 / math.Sqrt(float64(sa.headDim)))
180: 	scaleNode := gorgonia.NewScalar(sa.graph, tensor.Float32, gorgonia.WithValue(scale))
181: 	scores, err = gorgonia.HadamardProd(scores, scaleNode)

196: 	// }

199: 	// if training && sa.dropout > 0 {

201: 	// 	if err != nil {

214: type MultiHeadAttention struct {
215: 	graph       *gorgonia.ExprGraph

223: func NewMultiHeadAttention(g *gorgonia.ExprGraph, embedDim, numHeads int, dropout float64, seqLen int) *MultiHeadAttention {
224: 	headDim := embedDim / numHeads
225: 
226: 	heads := make([]*SelfAttention, numHeads)
227: 	for i := 0; i < numHeads; i++ {
228: 		heads[i] = NewSelfAttention(g, embedDim, headDim, dropout, seqLen)
229: 	}
230: 
231: 	wOut := gorgonia.NewMatrix(g, tensor.Float32,
232: 		gorgonia.WithShape(headDim, embedDim),
233: 		gorgonia.WithName("w_output"),
234: 		gorgonia.WithInit(gorgonia.GlorotN(1.0)),
235: 	)
236: 
237: 	return &MultiHeadAttention{
238: 		graph:    g,
239: 		heads:    heads,
240: 		wOutput:  wOut,
241: 		numHeads: numHeads,
242: 		embedDim: embedDim,
243: 		headDim:  headDim,
244: 	}
245: }

247: func (mha *MultiHeadAttention) Forward(x *gorgonia.Node, mask *gorgonia.Node, training bool) (*gorgonia.Node, error) {
248: 	headOutputs := make([]*gorgonia.Node, mha.numHeads)
249: 	for i := 0; i < mha.numHeads; i++ {
250: 		out, err := mha.heads[i].Forward(x, mask, training)
251: 		if err != nil {
252: 			return nil, err
253: 		}
254: 		headOutputs[i] = out
255: 	}
256: 
257: 	// Sum the head outputs instead of concatenating
258: 	result := headOutputs[0]
259: 	for i := 1; i < len(headOutputs); i++ {
260: 		var err error
261: 		result, err = gorgonia.Add(result, headOutputs[i])
262: 		if err != nil {
263: 			return nil, err
264: 		}
265: 	}
266: 
267: 	output, err := gorgonia.Mul(result, mha.wOutput)
268: 	if err != nil {
269: 		return nil, err
270: 	}
271: 
272: 	return output, nil
273: }

382: func NewGPT(g *gorgonia.ExprGraph, config *GorgoniteConfig) *GPT {
383: 	embedding := NewEmbeddingLayer(g, config.VocabSize, config.EmbedDim, config.ContextLen)
384: 	posEncoding := NewPositionalEncoding(g, config.ContextLen, config.EmbedDim)
385: 
386: 	blocks := make([]*TransformerBlock, config.NumLayers)
387: 	for i := 0; i < config.NumLayers; i++ {
388: 		blocks[i] = NewTransformerBlock(g, config.EmbedDim, config.NumHeads, config.DropoutRate, config.ContextLen)
389: 	}
390: 
391: 	outputLayer := gorgonia.NewMatrix(g, tensor.Float32,
392: 		gorgonia.WithShape(config.EmbedDim, config.VocabSize),
393: 		gorgonia.WithName("output_projection"),
394: 		gorgonia.WithInit(gorgonia.GlorotN(1.0)),
395: 	)
396: 
397: 	// Collect learnable nodes (weights)
398: 	learnables := []*gorgonia.Node{embedding.embeddings, outputLayer}
399: 	// Attention and FFN weights from blocks
400: 	for _, block := range blocks {
401: 		learnables = append(learnables, block.attention.wOutput)
402: 		for _, head := range block.attention.heads {
403: 			learnables = append(learnables, head.wQuery, head.wKey, head.wValue)
404: 		}
405: 		learnables = append(learnables, block.feedForward.w1, block.feedForward.w2)
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	gpt := &GPT{
409: 		graph:       g,
410: 		config:      config,
411: 		embedding:   embedding,
412: 		posEncoding: posEncoding,
413: 		blocks:      blocks,
414: 		outputLayer: outputLayer,
415: 		learnables:  learnables,
416: 	}
417: 
418: 	// Build the graph
419: 	seqLen := config.ContextLen
420: 	x, err := embedding.Forward(seqLen)
421: 	if err != nil {
422: 		panic(err)
423: 	}
424: 
425: 	// posEnc, err := posEncoding.Forward(seqLen)
426: 	// if err != nil {
427: 	// 	panic(err)
428: 	// }
429: 
430: 	// x, err = gorgonia.Add(x, posEnc)
431: 	// if err != nil {
432: 	// 	panic(err)
433: 	// }
434: 
435: 	mask := createCausalMask(g, seqLen)
436: 
437: 	for _, block := range blocks {
438: 		x, err = block.Forward(x, mask, false)
439: 		if err != nil {
440: 			panic(err)
441: 		}
442: 	}
443: 
444: 	logits, err := gorgonia.Mul(x, outputLayer)
445: 	if err != nil {
446: 		panic(err)
447: 	}
448: 
449: 	gpt.logits = logits
450: 
451: 	loss, err := gorgonia.Mean(logits)
452: 	if err != nil {
453: 		panic(err)
454: 	}
455: 	gpt.loss = loss
456: 
457: 	fmt.Printf("Graph has %d nodes\n", len(g.AllNodes()))
458: 
459: 	return gpt
460: }

466: func createCausalMask(_ *gorgonia.ExprGraph, seqLen int) *gorgonia.Node {
467: 	maskData := make([]float32, seqLen*seqLen)
468: 	for i := 0; i < seqLen; i++ {
469: 		for j := i + 1; j < seqLen; j++ {
470: 			maskData[i*seqLen+j] = -1e10
471: 		}
472: 	}
473: 
474: 	maskTensor := tensor.New(
475: 		tensor.WithBacking(maskData),
476: 		tensor.WithShape(seqLen, seqLen),
477: 	)
478: 
479: 	return gorgonia.NewConstant(maskTensor)
480: }

533: func TrainModel(model *GPT, dataset *Dataset, config TrainConfig) error {
534: 	vm := gorgonia.NewTapeMachine(model.graph, gorgonia.BindDualValues())
535: 	defer vm.Close()
536: 
537: 	solver := gorgonia.NewVanillaSolver(gorgonia.WithLearnRate(config.LearningRate))
538: 
539: 	for epoch := 0; epoch < config.NumEpochs; epoch++ {
540: 		epochLoss := 0.0
541: 
542: 		for i := 0; i < len(dataset.inputs); i += config.BatchSize {
543: 			_, err := model.Forward(true)
544: 			if err != nil {
545: 				return fmt.Errorf("forward pass error: %w", err)
546: 			}
547: 
548: 			loss := model.loss
549: 
550: 			if err := vm.RunAll(); err != nil {
551: 				return fmt.Errorf("VM execution error: %w", err)
552: 			}
553: 
554: 			fmt.Printf("Debug: Loss node ID: %d, Shape: %v\n", loss.ID(), loss.Shape())
555: 			fmt.Printf("Debug: Computing gradients for %d learnables\n", len(model.learnables))
556: 
557: 			grads, err := gorgonia.Grad(loss, model.learnables...)
558: 			if err != nil {
559: 				fmt.Printf("Debug: gorgonia.Grad failed: %v\n", err)
560: 				return fmt.Errorf("backward pass error: %w", err)
561: 			}
562: 
563: 			fmt.Printf("Debug: Gradients computed successfully for %d nodes\n", len(grads))
564: 			for i, g := range grads {
565: 				if g != nil {
566: 					fmt.Printf("Debug: Grad %d ID: %d, Shape: %v\n", i, g.ID(), g.Shape())
567: 				} else {
568: 					fmt.Printf("Debug: Grad %d is nil\n", i)
569: 				}
570: 			}
571: 
572: 			// Run backward pass to compute gradient values
573: 			if err := vm.RunAll(); err != nil {
574: 				fmt.Printf("Debug: Backward VM run failed: %v\n", err)
575: 				return fmt.Errorf("backward VM run error: %w", err)
576: 			}
577: 
578: 			valueGrads := gorgonia.NodesToValueGrads(grads)
579: 			fmt.Printf("Debug: Converted to %d ValueGrads\n", len(valueGrads))
580: 			for i, vg := range valueGrads {
581: 				gradVal, err := vg.Grad()
582: 				if err != nil {
583: 					fmt.Printf("Debug: ValueGrad %d grad error: %v\n", i, err)
584: 				} else if gradVal != nil {
585: 					fmt.Printf("Debug: ValueGrad %d has grad value, shape: %v\n", i, gradVal.Shape())
586: 				} else {
587: 					fmt.Printf("Debug: ValueGrad %d has nil grad value\n", i)
588: 				}
589: 			}
590: 
591: 			if err := solver.Step(valueGrads); err != nil {
592: 				fmt.Printf("Debug: Solver step failed: %v\n", err)
593: 				// Print more details about the graph
594: 				fmt.Printf("Debug: Graph nodes: %d\n", len(model.graph.AllNodes()))
595: 				for _, node := range model.graph.AllNodes() {
596: 					if node.Value() != nil {
597: 						fmt.Printf("Debug: Node %d (%s): shape %v, has value\n", node.ID(), node.Name(), node.Shape())
598: 					} else {
599: 						fmt.Printf("Debug: Node %d (%s): shape %v, no value\n", node.ID(), node.Name(), node.Shape())
600: 					}
601: 				}
602: 				return fmt.Errorf("solver step error: %w", err)
603: 			}
604: 
605: 			vm.Reset()
606: 
607: 			lossValue := loss.Value().Data().(float32)
608: 			epochLoss += float64(lossValue)
609: 		}
610: 
611: 		avgLoss := epochLoss / float64(len(dataset.inputs)/config.BatchSize)
612: 		fmt.Printf("Epoch %d: Loss = %.4f\n", epoch, avgLoss)
613: 
614: 		if epoch%config.SaveFreq == 0 {
615: 			SaveModel(model, fmt.Sprintf("checkpoint_epoch_%d.bin", epoch))
616: 		}
617: 	}
618: 
619: 	return nil
620: }

623: func SaveModel(model *GPT, filepath string) error {
624: 	file, err := os.Create(filepath)
625: 	if err != nil {
626: 		return err
627: 	}
628: 	defer file.Close()
629: 
630: 	encoder := gob.NewEncoder(file)
631: 
632: 	params := make(map[string][]float32)
633: 
634: 	for _, node := range model.graph.AllNodes() {
635: 		if node.Value() != nil {
636: 			data := node.Value().Data()
637: 			switch v := data.(type) {
638: 			case []float32:
639: 				params[node.Name()] = v
640: 			case []float64:
641: 				f32 := make([]float32, len(v))
642: 				for i, val := range v {
643: 					f32[i] = float32(val)
644: 				}
645: 				params[node.Name()] = f32
646: 			}
647: 		}
648: 	}
649: 
650: 	return encoder.Encode(params)
651: }

682: 	copy(tokens, startTokens)

714: func SampleToken(logits []float32, temperature float32, topK int) int {

718: 		}
719: 	}
720: 
721: 	maxLogit := logits[0]
722: 	for _, l := range logits {
723: 		if l > maxLogit {
724: 			maxLogit = l
725: 		}
726: 	}
727: 
728: 	expSum := float32(0)
729: 	probs := make([]float32, len(logits))
730: 	for i, l := range logits {
731: 		probs[i] = float32(math.Exp(float64(l - maxLogit)))
732: 		expSum += probs[i]
733: 	}
734: 
735: 	for i := range probs {
736: 		probs[i] /= expSum
737: 	}

739: 	if topK > 0 && topK < len(probs) {
740: 		type indexedProb struct {
741: 			idx  int
742: 			prob float32
743: 		}
744: 
745: 		indexed := make([]indexedProb, len(probs))

756: 		}

759: 		for _, p := range probs {

764: 		}
765: 	}

773: 		}
774: 	}

25: func (wg *WazeroGate) Compile(source string) error {
26: 	ctx := context.Background()
27: 
28: 	compilerConfig := wazero.NewCompilerConfig()
29: 	runtime := wazero.NewRuntimeWithConfig(ctx, compilerConfig)
30: 
31: 	wazergo.MustInstantiate(ctx, runtime)
32: 
33: 	compiled, err := runtime.CompileModule(ctx, source)
34: 	if err != nil {
35: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to compile WASM: %w", err)
36: 	}
37: 
38: 	wg.runtime = runtime
39: 	wg.compiled = compiled
40: 	return nil
41: }

43: func (wg *WazeroGate) CompileAndRun(source string, args ...string) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
44: 	if err := wg.Compile(source); err != nil {
45: 		return nil, err
46: 	}
47: 	return wg.Run(args...)
48: }
49: 
50: func (wg *WazeroGate) Run(args ...string) (map[string]interface{}, error) {
51: 	ctx := context.Background()
52: 
53: 	if wg.compiled == nil {
54: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no compiled module")
55: 	}
56: 
57: 	module, err := wg.runtime.InstantiateModule(ctx, wg.compiled)
58: 	if err != nil {
59: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to instantiate module: %w", err)
60: 	}
61: 
62: 	wg.module = module
63: 
64: 	results := make(map[string]interface{})
65: 
66: 	exports := module.(*wazero.ModuleInstance).Exports
67: 	for name, fn := range exports {
68: 		if v := module.ExportedFunctionDefinitions(); v != nil {
69: 			if fnDef, ok := v[name]; ok {
70: 				if len(fnDef.ParamTypes()) > 0 {
71: 					switch name {
72: 					case "GuardrailClass", "ErrorClass", "PatchScope":
73: 						if results[name] = fn.Call(); results[name] != nil {
74: 							results[name] = results[name]
75: 						}
76: 					}
77: 				}
78: 			}
79: 		}
80: 	}
81: 
82: 	if err := module.Close(ctx); err != nil {
83: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to close module: %w", err)
84: 	}
85: 
86: 	wg.execResults = results
87: 	return results, nil
88: }

90: func (wg *WazeroGate) CallFunction(name string, params ...interface{}) (interface{}, error) {
91: 	if wg.module == nil {
92: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("no module instantiated")
93: 	}
94: 
95: 	externalName := name
96: 	fn := wg.module.ExportedFunctionDefinitions()[externalName]
97: 	if fn == nil {

99: 	}
100: 
101: 	ctx := context.Background()
102: 
103: 	var paramsList []uint64
104: 	for _, p := range params {
105: 		switch v := p.(type) {
106: 		case uint32:
107: 			paramsList = append(paramsList, uint64(v))
108: 		case uint64:
109: 			paramsList = append(paramsList, v)
110: 		case int:
111: 			paramsList = append(paramsList, uint64(v))
112: 		case float32:
113: 			paramsList = append(paramsList, uint64(int32(v)))
114: 		case float64:
115: 			paramsList = append(paramsList, uint64(v))
116: 		default:
117: 			paramsList = append(paramsList, 0)
118: 		}
119: 	}
120: 
121: 	if len(paramsList) > 0 {
122: 		results, err := fn.Call(ctx, paramsList...)
123: 		if err != nil {
124: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("function call failed: %w", err)
125: 		}
126: 		if len(results) > 0 {
127: 			return results[0], nil
128: 		}
129: 	}

131: 	return nil, nil
